source.description: Execution is pinned by archived source and artifact SHA-256. recordedAtCommit identifies catalog registration; it does not claim dirty execution sources were committed.

variants.method: root Q coefficient 0.2 instead of 0.4; otherwise unchanged 8-root halving
root Q coefficient 0.8 instead of 0.4; otherwise unchanged 8-root halving
evaluate top16 once, prune to4 at first elimination, then ordinary halving; all within64 visits
keep top6; add up to2 tactical-scored actions from outside top6; fill remaining slots from prior ranking; at most8 total; no prior/value bonus
keep top8 plus up to4 tactical extras, computed after root NN only for outside candidates; skip heuristics for pass-only roots
ordinary PUCT at root; final choice uses log(prior)+0.4*(50+max child visits)*Q over viable actions visited at least twice; proofs still override; fallback original visits if no such action
